summary: Frontend-only smoke test for Language Auto-Detect (iteration 6). Verified initialLang()/detectLang() logic via Playwright: created fresh browser contexts overriding navigator.language/languages and clearing localStorage 'bis-lang' with add_init_script, then loaded the external preview URL. All four scenarios (hi-IN, ta-IN, bn-IN, fr-FR) rendered the expected localized nav strings (डैशबोर्ड / டாஷ்போர்டு / ড্যাশবোর্ড / Dashboard). Stickiness confirmed: after first-visit auto-detect, localStorage 'bis-lang'='hi' and a subsequent load with fr-FR locale still renders Hindi. Manual override verified: pre-seeding 'bis-lang'='en' with hi-IN locale renders English (auto-detect does not override stored value). Clicking [data-testid=lang-ta] updates UI to Tamil and persists 'bis-lang'='ta'. No console errors observed. No code changes made.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n/index.tsx LanguageProvider effect always writes localStorage on mount — this correctly makes the auto-detected language sticky. Implementation matches the spec.

Minor: language switcher buttons share the same base className in DOM inspection; ensure the active-variant styling (visible in screenshot as dark pill on EN) is being applied via conditional class — not a bug, just noting selector-based active detection via aria-pressed is not present. Consider adding aria-pressed for a11y and test hooks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-detect uses navigator.languages/language. To simulate first visit reliably, use browser.new_context(locale=...) plus add_init_script to override navigator.language/languages AND localStorage.removeItem('bis-lang') BEFORE navigation. LanguageProvider useEffect writes 'bis-lang' on mount so subsequent reads should show the detected code (in one test iteration the immediate readback returned null despite correct UI language — likely a timing/init-script re-run artifact; sticky reload test confirmed persistence works). All 6 acceptance scenarios (4 locales + sticky + manual override + manual click) passed.
